# Draft:Sighireanu Software Solutions e.U.

----
Sighireanu Software Solutions e.U. is an Austrian software and information technology services company based in Upper Austria. The company operates as a registered sole proprietorship (eingetragenes Unternehmen, e.U.) and focuses on software-as-a-service (SaaS) development, automation solutions, and technical IT consulting.
History
Sighireanu Software Solutions e.U. was founded in October 2025 by Romanian software developer and entrepreneur Alex-Christian Sighireanu. The company was officially registered in the Austrian Firmenbuch on 14 October 2025 under the company number FN 664292a.
Activities
The company specializes in the development and operation of digital software solutions for business clients. Its activities include:
* Development and operation of SaaS platforms
* Automation and digitalization of business processes
* Technical consulting, system integration, and configuration
* IT services related to cloud-based and web-based applications
The company primarily serves small enterprises.
Founder
Alex-Christian Sighireanu is a Romanian software developer and entrepreneur. He founded Sighireanu Software Solutions e.U. to consolidate his work in software development, automation, and digital infrastructure into a single business entity.
Legal status
* Legal form: Sole proprietorship (eingetragenes Unternehmen – e.U.)
* Country: Austria
* Industry: Software development and IT services
